2609.06893.title: Towards Bridging the Gap Between Offline and Iterative Alignment via Preference Distillation
2609.06893.paper_summary: Direct preference optimization DPO is a promising offline approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) due to its simplicity, computational efficiency, and implicit modeling of human preferences. Interestingly, iterative extensions of DPO have achieved stronger performance on academic benchmarks, raising two key questions: (i) Why do iterative methods generally outperform offline ones? (ii) Can their advantages be incorporated into offline alignment? To answer the first question, our controlled experiments reveal that the explicit preference model, additionally introduced in the iterative procedure, is a key factor behind its superiority over offline methods. This insight leads us to answer the second question affirmatively and propose Distilled Preference Probability Policy Optimization (DP3O), an effective and efficient offline alignment algorithm. DP3O first learns an explicit preference model using a helper class of LLMs and then distills its knowledge into policy optimization. Theoretically, we show that explicit preference modeling admits better estimation error control than implicit formulations, and that DP3O achieves a tighter generalization bound than hard-label DPO through variance reduction. Empirically, we evaluate DP3O on a wide range of chat-based and downstream tasks and show that it outperforms state-of-the-art offline methods, achieves performance comparable to iterative DPO, and reduces training time by about $42\%$, demonstrating both its effectiveness and efficiency.
2609.06893.paper_summary_zh: 直接偏好優化（DPO）是一種有前景的離線方法，用於對齊大型語言模型（LLMs），因為它的簡單性、計算效率和對人類偏好的隱性建模。<lb/>有趣的是，DPO 的迭代擴展在學術基準上取得了更強的表現，提出了兩個關鍵問題：（i）為什麼迭代方法通常優於離線方法？（ii）它們的優勢能否融入離線對齊中？<lb/>為了回答第一個問題，我們的控制實驗顯示，在迭代過程中額外引入的顯性偏好模型是其優於離線方法的關鍵因素。<lb/>這一見解使我們能夠肯定地回答第二個問題，並提出了蒸餾偏好概率政策優化（DP3O），這是一種有效且高效的離線對齊算法。<lb/>DP3O 首先使用一類輔助的 LLM 學習顯性偏好模型，然後將其知識蒸餾到政策優化中。<lb/>理論上，我們表明顯性偏好建模在估計誤差控制方面優於隱性公式，並且 DP3O 通過方差減少實現了比硬標籤 DPO 更緊的泛化界限。<lb/>在實證上，我們在廣泛的基於聊天的和下游任務上評估 DP3O，並顯示它超越了最先進的離線方法，達到了與迭代 DPO 可比的性能，並將訓練時間減少了約 $42\%$，展示了其有效性和效率。
